title: John 8:49-51 — whoever keeps My word will never see death
summary: John 8:49-51: Jesus answers that He does not have a demon but honors His Father, that He does not seek His own glory because there is One who seeks and judges, and that anyone who keeps His word will never see death. Jesus' words (I, My, Me, Jesus) are in red and 'Father' is in blue.

text.text: 49 Jesus answered, “I do not have a demon; but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
50 “But I do not seek My glory; there is One who seeks and judges.
51 “Truly, truly, I say to you, if anyone keeps My word he will never see death.”

keywords: I seek not mine own glory
there is one that seeketh and judgeth
if a man keep my saying he shall never see death
